message.name: AccountDetailsConfirmationV08
message.definition: Scope|The AccountDetailsConfirmation message is sent by an account servicer, for example, a registrar, transfer agent, custodian bank or securities depository to the account owner, for example, an investor to confirm the opening of an account, execution of an AccountModificationInstruction or to return information requested in a GetAccountDetails message.|Usage|The AccountDetailsConfirmation message is used to confirm the opening of an account, modification of an account or the provision of information requested in a previously sent GetAccountDetails message. The message contains detailed information relevant to the opened account.|When the AccountDetailsConfirmation is used to confirm execution of an AccountModificationInstruction message, it may:|- contain the modified subsets of account details that were specified in the AccountModificationInstruction, and/or|- provide the status of the account.|When the AccountModificationInstruction message is used to instruct the closure of an account, the AccountDetailsConfirmation message is used to confirm the account has been closed. |When the AccountDetailsConfirmation is used to reply to a GetAccountDetails message, it returns the selected subsets of account details that were specified in the GetAccountDetails message.

rules.name: ClosedStatus1Rule
rules.text: If Closed is present then Enabled is not allowed.

rules.name: EnabledDisabledStatus1Rule
rules.text: If Enabled is present, then Disabled is not allowed.

rules.name: EnabledDisabledStatus2Rule
rules.text: If Disabled is present, then Enabled is not allowed.

rules.name: ClosedStatus3Rule
rules.text: If Closed is present then Pending is not allowed.

rules.name: ClosedStatus2Rule
rules.text: If Closed is present then Disabled is not allowed.

rules.name: ClosedStatus4Rule
rules.text: If Closed is present then PendingOpening is not allowed.

rules.name: ClosedStatus5Rule
rules.text: If Closed is present then Proforma is not allowed.

rules.name: ClosedStatus6Rule
rules.text: If Closed is present then ClosurePending is not allowed.

rules.name: StatusElementRule
rules.text: One of the elements (Enabled, Disabled, Pending, PendingOpening, Proforma, Closed, ClosurePending, Other) must be present.

rules.name: PartialHoldingUnits1Rule
rules.text: If BlockHolding is NPRH (NonPartialHolding) then PartialHoldingUnits must not be present.

rules.name: PartialHoldingUnits2Rule
rules.text: If BlockHolding is PRTH (PartialHolding) then PartialHoldingUnits is mandatory.

rules.name: PartialHoldingUnits3Rule
rules.text: If BlockHolding is CERT (Certificate) then PartialHoldingUnits must not be present.

rules.name: HoldingCertificateNumberRule
rules.text: If BlockHolding is CERT (Certificate) then HoldingCertificateNumber is mandatory.

rules.name: IdentificationGuideline
rules.text: It is recommended that ISIN is used in Identification.|When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: FinancialInstrumentDetailsGuideline
rules.text: FinancialInstrumentDetails may be present if a single investment fund is associated to the investment account. If several investment funds are associated to the investment account, the FundFamilyName only should be specified.

rules.name: IncomePreferenceReinvestment1Rule
rules.text: If IncomePreference is CASH (Cash), then ReinvestmentDetails is not allowed.

rules.name: ReinvestmentPercentage1Rule
rules.text: Sum of all occurrences of ReinvestmentDetails/ReinvestmentPercentage must not be greater than 100.

rules.name: MailingIndicatorRule
rules.text: If RegistrationAddressIndicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then MailingIndicator must be "true" or "1".

rules.name: OrganisationElementRule
rules.text: One of the elements (Name, ShortName, Identification, LegalEntityIdentifier, Purpose, RegistrationCountry, RegistrationDate, PostalAddress, TypeOfOrganisation, PlaceOfListing) must be present.

rules.name: PoliticallyExposedPersonTypeRule
rules.text: If PoliticallyExposedPersonType/Code is 'NoPoliticalExposure' (NPEX) then PoliticallyExposedPersonStatus is not allowed.

rules.name: OwnershipBeneficiaryRateRule
rules.text: Either Rate or Fraction must be present. Both may be present.

rules.name: ReferredPlacementAgentRule
rules.text: ReferredPlacementAgent may only be present if Referred is REFR (Referred).

rules.name: AmountRule
rules.text: If Quantity/Amount is not present, then GrossAmountIndicator is not allowed.

rules.name: ExtensionRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of the Registration Authority and without strict usage rules published by the Registration Authority.

rules.name: InvestmentAccountRule
rules.text: If ConfirmationDetails/ConfirmationType/Code is ACCO (AccountOpening), then InvestmentAccount must be present.

rules.name: UnitRule
rules.text: If SavingsInvestmentPlan is present, then SavingsInvestmentPlan/Quantity/Unit is not allowed.
